description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes, which provide an interface for secure socket communication, including certificate handling, validation, and socket state management within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure socket port with methods for connection management, data transmission, and event handling within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its associated context, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidator
classes.description: Interface for certificate validation callback, allowing custom validation logic.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class managing socket connection states, data transfer, and handshake validation, derived from Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is currently open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is currently closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is suspended.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket port has encountered an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Callback
methods.description: Sets or gets the callback validator for certificate validation.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the resource handle for the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Events
methods.description: Returns the event mask for the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket.
